{"CommandLine":"python -c "import urllib.request, json, os, time
cfg = json.load(open(os.path.expanduser(r'~/.config/configstore/firebase-tools.json')))
token = cfg['tokens']['access_token']
headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'}

url = 'https://firebasehosting.googleapis.com/v1beta1/projects/-/sites/ai-bs-dashboard/versions?pageSize=100'
with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url, headers=headers)) as r:
    data = json.loads(r.read().decode())

expired = [v for v in data.get('versions', []) if v.get('status') == 'EXPIRED']
print(f'Found {len(expired)} expired versions to delete...')

deleted_count = 0
for v in expired:
    v_name = v['name']
    req = urllib.request.Request(f'https://firebasehosting.googleapis.com/v1beta1/{v_name}', headers=headers, method='DELETE')
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as res:
            if res.status == 200:
                deleted_count += 1
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'Failed {v_name}: {e}')
    time.sleep(0.1)

print(f'Successfully deleted {deleted_count} expired versions.')
"","Cwd":"C:\AI-BS","WaitMsBeforeAsync":20000,"toolAction":"Deleting all expired versions to free hosting storage","toolSummary":"Purge expired hosting versions"}
